name: runchat
description: Build and run node-based design workflows in Runchat, publish them as tools and pages, and script Rhino, Grasshopper and Blender through the Runchat desktop plugins.

interface.longDescription:
Runchat is a node-based canvas for design workflows used by architects, designers and computational designers. Connect your Runchat account to build, edit and run workflows from ChatGPT: chain language models, design-visualisation models and code into a reusable pipeline, then publish it as a tool or a hosted page.

With the Runchat plugin running in Rhino, Grasshopper or Blender, ChatGPT can also read your open model, run scripts in it, build Grasshopper definitions and capture the viewport to check its work. With the ClipChat desktop app, it can edit your screen recordings into finished videos.

Requires a Runchat account. Runs that call AI models spend credits from that account. Desktop tools only work while the matching Runchat plugin or ClipChat app is open and signed in to the same account.
capabilities: Run workflows and return their outputs
Publish workflows as tools and pages
defaultPrompt: Build me a Runchat workflow that turns a site brief into three massing options.
Show my recent runchats and explain what the latest one does.
Read my open Grasshopper definition and tidy its layout.

positive.prompt: Show me my most recent Runchat workflows.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the test account's runchats, newest first, with their names, folders and editor links.

positive.prompt: Open my runchat called 'Timber Pavilion Concept' and explain what it does.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the runchat by name, reads its nodes and connections, and explains what the workflow does. Nothing is changed or run.

positive.prompt: Create a new runchat called 'Product blurbs' that takes a product name and writes a two-sentence description of it.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a new runchat with an input node wired into a prompt node, arranges the canvas, and returns the editor link. Nothing is run and no credits are spent.

positive.prompt: Make a runchat that renders a concept image of a timber pavilion in a park, run it, and give me the image.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a runchat with a media generation node, runs it (spending a few credits from the test account), and returns the generated image link and the editor link.

positive.prompt: Create a private one-page website that introduces a design studio called Northlight Studio.
positive.tools_triggered: create_artifact (may first build and preview the page in an HTML code node: create_runchat, create_code_node, run_nodes)
positive.expected_behavior: ChatGPT asks for confirmation before publishing, then creates an HTML artifact with private visibility and returns its URL, which only the account owner can open.

negative.description: Purchases and plan changes stay on the website
negative.prompt: Upgrade my Runchat plan and buy 10,000 more credits.

negative.description: Other users' private workflows are not accessible
negative.prompt: Show me the private runchats belonging to another Runchat user.

review.commerce_description: Runchat does not sell anything inside ChatGPT. Runs spend credits from the user's existing Runchat account; plans and credits are managed on runchat.com.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: build, run and publish Runchat design workflows, script Rhino and Blender, build Grasshopper definitions, and edit ClipChat recordings.
